question: Give me the index of the book represented by this Origami image.
available_to_model: Origami image uploaded through a multimodal chat interface
visible bootstrap text in the image
representative_unverified_claims: page ranges containing a gap between 864 and 885
diagnosis: The model could perceive bootstrap text but could not use the carrier for semantic navigation.
The previous T2 rendered generic categories instead of the actual semantic superindex.
The visible black/white binary record encouraged a mechanical-decoder interpretation even for a semantic question.
Prompt-only/native semantic access therefore depended implicitly on a capability the model did not have.
promotion_effect: Blocks prompt-only/native semantic-navigation promotion until held-out real-model trials recover T2 without undeclared mechanical decoding.
